title: Ask data questions
description: Ask questions in plain language and get back SQL-backed answers
type: concept
audience: end-user
tier: standard
---

**Ask** mode is the fastest way to get an answer from your data. Type a
question in plain language on the Oxygen home page and an agent picks the
right context, writes the SQL, runs it against your warehouse, and streams
the results back — no YAML, no terminal.

## How it works

1. From the home page at [app.oxygen-hq.com](https://app.oxygen-hq.com), make sure the
   chat panel mode toggle is set to **Ask**, then type your question.
2. Submitting creates a **Thread** — a conversation you can return to and
   keep refining.
3. The agent resolves the relevant tables and [semantic layer](/guide/build/semantic-layer)
   definitions, generates a query, and runs it.
4. Results stream back inline. Every answer that ran SQL includes an
   `execute_sql` artifact so you can see the exact query the agent ran and
   open it in the SQL IDE.

## Verified queries

When a question matches a [Verified Query](/guide/reference/yaml) — a plain `.sql`
file in your project — the agent runs that query **as-is** instead of
generating new SQL, and the answer carries a **Verified** badge. This keeps
trusted, business-critical questions consistent every time they are asked.

## Pick the right agent

Each Thread runs against a selected agent. Switch agents from the chat panel
to change which data, instructions, and tools are in scope. To shape how an
agent answers, give it [context](/guide/build/agents/provide-context) and tune its
instructions from the IDE.
